//: Swagger summaries for routes whose API.md wording only works inside a table. A cell reads
//1: under a section heading and after the row above it, so 'Delete one' or 'The same, paginated'
//2: is clear there and useless in Swagger, where the operation is read alone. These restate the
//3: same fact with its subject. update_swagger_descriptions.py prefers this file over both
//4: catalogues; run it with --report to see which routes still fall through to one.
GET /api/AppVersion/mobile/settings: The stored mobile app version policy
PUT /api/AppVersion/mobile/settings: Update the mobile app version policy
POST /api/approval-process/stages: Create an approval stage definition, or update an existing one
POST /api/approval-process/templates: Create an approval template, or update an existing one
POST /api/Auth/passkeys/register/options: Begin registering a passkey, returning the WebAuthn creation options and a session token
POST /api/Auth/passkeys/register/complet: Finish registering a passkey from the authenticator's response
POST /api/Auth/passkeys/login/complete: Finish a passkey sign-in, answering the same token pair as /api/Auth/login
POST /api/Backup/{id}/restore: Restore the database from a backup
PUT /api/crates/opening-balances/{crateT: Correct a crate opening balance, optionally replacing its attachment
GET /api/DesktopIntegration/queue: List invoices waiting to post to SAP
POST /api/DesktopIntegration/sales-order: Convert a sales order to an invoice
GET /api/DesktopIntegration/transfer-que: List transfers waiting to post to SAP
Queued transfers needing a human look
POST /api/DesktopIntegration/prices/pric: Sync the price lists from SAP
GET /api/DesktopIntegration/stock/{wareh: List the batches available for one item in one warehouse
POST /api/DesktopIntegration/transfers/q: Queue a stock transfer for background posting to SAP
GET /api/DesktopIntegration/transfer-que: Get a queued transfer's status by the caller's own reference
DELETE /api/DesktopIntegration/transfer-: Drop a queued transfer before it posts
POST /api/DesktopIntegration/transfer-qu: Retry a queued transfer that failed to post
GET /api/DesktopIntegration/transfers/wa: List a warehouse's transfers between two dates
POST /api/DesktopIntegration/prices/pric: Sync one price list's item prices from SAP
POST /api/Document/generate/download: Render a document and return the file
POST /api/Document/email: Render a document and email it
GET /api/Document/signatures: List the signatures on one document
POST /api/Document/templates/{id}/set-de: Make a template the default for its document type
PUT /api/Document/email-templates/{id}: Update an email template by its id
GET /api/Document/email-templates/{templ: Get an email template by its code
POST /api/exception-center/items/{source: Mark one exception centre item as seen
Take ownership of an exception centre item
GET /api/Merchandiser/mobile/active-prod: The mobile catalogue a merchandiser may sell from
GET /api/InventoryTransfer/{warehouseCod: List a warehouse's inventory transfers, paginated
GET /api/Invoice/{docEntry}/attachments/: Download one of an invoice's attachments
PUT /api/Quotation/{id}/reprice: Reprice a quotation against current prices
PUT /api/Shops/{id}: Change a shop's name, business partner, warehouse or cost centre
GET /api/Statement/generate/{cardCode}: Generate a customer statement as a PDF
POST /api/Stock/warehouse/{warehouseCode: A warehouse's sales, with the date range in the body rather than the query string
GET /api/UserManagement/me: Get the signed-in user's own profile
POST /api/vansales/auth/login: Sign a van sales handset in; rate-limited under the auth policy
POST /api/vansales/auth/refresh: Refresh a van sales handset's tokens; rate-limited under the auth policy
GET /api/vansales/customer/{code}/histor: What one shop has bought and still has on order, the detail the office's route customer report reads
POST /api/vansales/order/convert-to-invo: Convert a van sales order to an invoice; always answers 202
POST /api/whatsapp/sessions/{sessionId}/: Reply to a message in a WhatsApp session
